tools.description: Keyword search over the published Aidoptio articles (titles, excerpts, keywords and tags, English and Dutch). Returns the best matches with title, excerpt, date, category and EN/NL URLs. Please cite the article URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog, search_articles, get_service, get_disclosures · Private data: get_service, benchmark_readiness, ai_literacy_scan, prepare_intake_link · Public sink: prepare_intake_link · Destructive: plan_vendor_evaluation, verify_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog, search_articles, get_service, get_disclosures · Private data: get_service, benchmark_readiness, ai_literacy_scan, prepare_intake_link · Public sink: prepare_intake_link · Destructive: plan_vendor_evaluation, verify_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
